name: How much does it cost to make a garage entry accessible?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to make a garage entry accessible?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of making a garage entry accessible varies significantly based on the scope of work. Simple additions like grab bars or improved lighting are relatively inexpensive. Installing a new automatic garage door opener can range from a few hundred to over a thousand dollars. More extensive modifications, such as widening a doorway or building a custom ramp, will incur higher costs due to materials and labor. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely based on upgrades, from minor additions like grab bars to major renovations like widening doorways or building ramps.
